Name: QuadSpine
Description: This will create a QuadSpine System (v002: hip / chest controllers drive the end joints, even stretch and squash, matrix based, chained bind joints, tweakers)

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a QuadSpine System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- SetGameParent: bind joint the spine bind chain goes under (for example COG_Bnd), so the game skeleton (ConvertBody) gets Spine_A..G in a chain under it. Empty: the bind joints group. The bind joints are always a chain (Spine_A_Bnd > Spine_B_Bnd ...).
- JointCount: Guides = one joint per guide (default). 5 / 7 / 9 / 11 resample the spine evenly along the guides (joints named A, B, C...). The controllers stay on the guides (every other guide an IK controller, the others FK).
- Tweakers: one extra controller per joint (tweakCtrls on the spine attrs) to move, rotate and scale each bind joint.
- DefaultCtrls: which controllers show after the build: Both, IK or FK (IkMain / IkMid / FkForwards / FkBackwards attrs).
- Hip / chest: the first and last IK controllers drive the first / last joint orientation fully, the joints in between aim along the spine with the twist blended from hip to chest.
- Stretch (spine attrs): 1 the joints spread on the whole spine curve (even stretch, the chain ends on the chest controller), 0 they keep their length. Squash keeps the volume.
- Controllers scale: IK controllers scale the bind joints around them (fading to the next IK controller), FK controllers their joint, tweakers their own joint.
- Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
